facts.statement: The researchers created a new family of zwitterionic solvents intended to replace dimethyl sulfoxide in biological experiments.
facts.subject: other

facts.statement: The new solvents showed no toxicity when given orally and had much lower toxicity when injected intravenously compared to a previously reported solvent.
facts.subject: other

facts.statement: The new solvents allowed the delivery of drugs that could not be dissolved in water or dimethyl sulfoxide.
facts.subject: other

facts.statement: Using the new solvents instead of dimethyl sulfoxide reduced the unwanted activation of c-fos genes, which helps in studying the brain.
facts.subject: other

facts.statement: The authors suggest the solvent family could help develop 1000 to 5000 new drugs by making previously unusable drug candidates soluble.
facts.subject: other
